name: Mikaela Lane
source: A close friend of Kaison’s, whom he had known ever since they were children. A girl with corn-yellow hair and a delightful smile, whom he remembered well. The girl who saved his life. Who is now deceased – no, murdered. Murdered by Sho Reilen, who had the audacity to laugh, ”It was a whim, a whim. I killed her on a whim. Is that a good enough answer for you?”
